speaker: Zrix
text: Captain, this unnamed Rift is stable enough to stand in, but not enough to solve anything important.

speaker: Zrix
text: A Rift without a name is just a crack in the Zshell. Named sessions have addresses the ship can find later. Unnamed ones vanish when you leave.

speaker: Zrix
text: The overflow buffer is already eating the eastern path. Find the Rift Code first. The armory will not answer a nameless jump.

speaker: Zrix
text: The Rift Code is further east. Collect it and return. I will be here.
